notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.5.10 corrects the Frost-native Garage bridge before user testing: plain PKZ extraction now keeps root-level model.edf/model.geom and arbitrary split-part EDF names instead of requiring internal filenames to repeat the bike ID, and native-fit protection keeps its authored origin instead of being recentered. The real Frost-based EDF/PNT pipeline, selected rider.edf and selected helmet/boots/protection EDFs, .geom bike assembly, seven Garage dropdown tabs, native MX Bikes profile sync, background performance path, stay-open hot updates and the working taskbar icon are preserved. No generic bike/rider stand-in and no MX Bikes process is used by Garage; locked/non-ZIP PKZs fail closed rather than showing fake geometry.
